file_insights.purpose: Comprehensive reproduction document capturing MASTER_PROMPT behavior on greenfield Next.js 14 project

patterns_discovered.description: Sequential stages: detection (file exists check) → analysis (stack inference) → generation (ARCHITECTURE.md) → validation (file creation)

patterns_discovered.pattern: implicit file creation without explicit instruction
patterns_discovered.description: MASTER_PROMPT says 'pin decisions in ARCHITECTURE.md' but doesn't explicitly state CREATE operation
patterns_discovered.evidence: Line: 'Pin decisions in `ARCHITECTURE.md` at the repo root' lacks actionable verb

patterns_discovered.description: Single MASTER_PROMPT covers 11+ distinct concerns (App Router, data fetching, state, styling, components, FS access, Claude rules, performance, release, risks, phases)
patterns_discovered.evidence: Simulated ARCHITECTURE.md covers all topics without delegation

patterns_discovered.description: Pipeline Phase 1 assumes ARCHITECTURE.md + PROJECT_MAP.md exist; MASTER_PROMPT doesn't guarantee either for new projects
patterns_discovered.evidence: Issues section: 'CRITICAL: New-Project Detection Not Explicit'

gotchas_discovered.issue: 'Pin decisions in ARCHITECTURE.md' does not specify CREATE vs UPDATE vs REFERENCE
gotchas_discovered.consequence: Claude may output markdown without writing file, or assume file exists when it doesn't

gotchas_discovered.issue: Integration rules reference PROJECT_MAP.md reading, but MASTER_PROMPT doesn't specify creation path for new projects
gotchas_discovered.consequence: Pipeline Phase 1 (context load) expects PROJECT_MAP.md; fails if missing with unclear error

gotchas_discovered.issue: New projects lack README; MASTER_PROMPT doesn't mention generating one
gotchas_discovered.consequence: Greenfield projects lack day-one documentation without manual developer work

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: missing error handling for non-existent files
gotchas_discovered.issue: MASTER_PROMPT assumes ARCHITECTURE.md exists for 'Phase 1: Initial Analysis' but doesn't handle FileNotFoundError
gotchas_discovered.consequence: Unclear developer experience if files missing at session start

gotchas_discovered.issue: If ARCHITECTURE.md exists but is incomplete, unclear if MASTER_PROMPT merges or overwrites
gotchas_discovered.consequence: Risk of data loss or incomplete architecture state

deliverables: Simulated expected output for MASTER_PROMPT on new Next.js project
validation_performed: Verified MASTER_PROMPT coverage of 11 architectural concerns
gaps_exposed: MASTER_PROMPT doesn't explicitly handle new-project CREATE operation
No guidance on file operation semantics (CREATE vs UPDATE)
Missing error handling for absent architectural files

recommendations.detail: Add explicit instructions: 'For new projects (no ARCHITECTURE.md exists): Generate and CREATE ARCHITECTURE.md at repo root'
recommendations.impact: Eliminates ambiguity; makes CREATE operation explicit

recommendations.detail: Specify if PROJECT_MAP.md is (a) generated by MASTER_PROMPT, (b) optional, or (c) developer-created separately
recommendations.impact: Unblocks pipeline Phase 1 for new projects

recommendations.action: add README.md generation to new-project flow
recommendations.detail: Include basic README.md with project name, stack, quick start in MASTER_PROMPT output
Update pipeline.md Phase 1 to handle missing ARCHITECTURE.md/PROJECT_MAP.md with clear user guidance

recommendations.action: test MASTER_PROMPT in real Claude Code session
recommendations.detail: Execute reproduction with actual Claude Code to verify documented behavior matches implementation

recommendations.action: document merge strategy for partial ARCHITECTURE.md
recommendations.detail: Specify: if ARCHITECTURE.md exists but sections missing, MASTER_PROMPT should MERGE (preserve existing, add new sections)
recommendations.impact: Prevents data loss; enables iterative architecture refinement
